dialogues.speaker: Zhi
dialogues.text: Hello. How may I help you?

dialogues.speaker: Zhi
dialogues.text: Ah. I'm memorizing the names of herbs.

dialogues.speaker: Zhi
dialogues.text: I mean, when you go picking herbs in the mountains, if you don't even know what you're picking, wouldn't that be something of a joke?

dialogues.speaker: Zhi
dialogues.text: Yes. Many people my age have gone to Liyue Harbor to work or settle down. I, however, have decided to stay here.

dialogues.speaker: Zhi
dialogues.text: I guess I was born with the nose of the mountain people. I just can't get used to the sea-salt tinge and the flavors of a city by the shore.

dialogues.speaker: Zhi
dialogues.text: What's more, the older folks in the village can't quite walk well anymore, so I have to help them pick herbs.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'll leave you to it, then.

dialogues.speaker: Zhi
dialogues.text: See you, and watch your step!
